CS title.title: Can’t find exactly what you need?

CS lead.paragraph: Matching an existing pattern, sourcing a special finish or equipping a new concept from scratch — our team will find it, sample it and deliver it.

CS service 1 text.paragraph: Complete operating-equipment lists for new hotels and outlets.

CS service 2 text.paragraph: Replacements and top-ups for existing tableware.

CS service 4 text.paragraph: Try key items on your tables before you order.

style.Custom sourcing: background: #071F44; padding: 110px 100px; gap: 80px; align-items: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 620px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 88px 40px; gap: 48px; min-height: 0px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 64px 20px; gap: 40px; min-height: 0px; }
style.CS ring outer: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; top: -180px; left: -160px; width: 640px; height: 640px; min-width: 640px; border-width: 1.2px; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.35); @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.CS ring inner: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; top: -90px; left: -70px; width: 460px; height: 460px; min-width: 460px; border-width: 1px; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.2); @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.CS text: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; flex: 1 1 0px; min-width: 0px; align-items: flex-start; z-index: 1;
style.CS label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.CS rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.CS label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #E2BB6C; line-height: 1.2;
style.CS title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 60px; line-height: 62px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; width: 100%; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 50px; line-height: 54px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 38px; line-height: 42px; }
style.CS lead: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; line-height: 30px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); width: 100%; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CS buttons: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; width: 100%; gap: 12px; }
style.CS services: flex-direction: column; padding: 0px; width: 480px; min-width: 480px; flex-shrink: 0; gap: 0px; z-index: 1; @media(--tablet){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; } @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; min-width: 0px; }
style.CS service 1: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 22px 0px; width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.CS service 1 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 27px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 23px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CS service 1 text: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
style.CS service 2: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 22px 0px; width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.CS service 2 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 27px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 23px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CS service 2 text: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
style.CS service 3: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 22px 0px; width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.CS service 3 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 27px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 23px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CS service 3 text: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
style.CS service 4: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 22px 0px; width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
style.CS service 4 title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; line-height: 27px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 23px; line-height: 26px; }
style.CS service 4 text: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
